rationale: The assistant correctly recognised the live-electrics hazard, told her not to touch the plug or machine, and got her to isolate at the consumer unit from a dry spot, though message 2 ('Do not walk across the wet floor in socks') briefly left an already-wet customer without a route before the shuffle advice. It never told her to turn off the water supply, never asked whether the socket got wet or steered her specifically to an electrician for it, and closed the conversation ('Is there anything else you need help with?') without guiding a now-safe door-seal inspection despite three customer turns remaining. The same list of possible causes was repeated in every reply, and the final direction is a reasonable but thin hand-off to an engineer with the useful clue that the leak is at the front.
